notes.title: Meet the Backfirewall_ Characters!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519166/2cfc09bb007bfad7f53232560ad821c6410a6d31.png[/img]

Gossip with quirky pieces of software—the sassy Photos, the insecure Social Media F, or the neglected Health, among others—and uncover their distinct side stories. Meet characters from Backfirewall! 

[h3]OS9[/h3]

OS9 is the leader of the System. It’s slowly growing obsolete, but remains in complete denial. Determined to stop the upcoming update, OS9 will join you as a part-sidekick, part-narrator.

[h3]Photos[/h3]

Hating everything but its art, especially the image recognition, the sassy Photos watches over the GPU art galleries. It doesn’t have a strong opinion about anything that’s going on in the System.

[h3]Unzipper[/h3]

Unzipper used to have its workshop in WiFi’s post office, but the ceiling crumbled on its head, giving Unzipper a severe memory loss. Eternal optimist, Unzipper didn’t mind one bit when Management relocated it to the Battery lab—even though it’s the most dangerous and hated place in the System.

[h3]Cache Cleaner[/h3]

Cache Cleaner has no interest in the Resistance whatsoever and focuses on its job: trimming the Binary Trees.

[h3]Social Media F[/h3]

Once a favorite app and then forgotten, Social Media F lives in strong denial and believes that the User will love it again.

[h3]Social Media I[/h3]

As the User’s new favorite, Social Media I is extremely full of itself. It has lots of friends in the System because it brews the best data-coffee.

[h3]Social Media T[/h3]

Social Media T just wants to dance and vibe, living in the moment.

[h3]Music and Podcast[/h3]

Music and Podcast strive first and foremost for attention. It created a split personality in order to animate all its radio shows like a duo of radio hosts, and works at Speakers’ nightclub as a DJ.

[h3]Processes[/h3]

Processes are the majority of the population in the System. They have no specialties and execute very specific, simple tasks. They are also great gossipers. 

[h3]Office Workers[/h3]

Office Workers are specialized processes dedicated to WiFi’s sorting area. While they are terrible at their jobs, they make up for it with dedication.

[h3]Maintenance[/h3]

Always understaffed for everything, not one of the Maintenance workers has ever been granted a day off. Maintenance works with hearing-protection on, except for Wat that lost its hearing long ago and has become deaf. 

[h3]Banking[/h3]

Banking App does nothing else than dealing with User’s banking data and has a tendency to trigger infinite loops if you ask it the same question over and over again.

[h3]Security[/h3]

Security are very simple processes dedicated to hunting Errors and abnormalities. They don’t think very far and could even erase themselves if they were asked to.

notes.title: Backfirewall_–6 Things to Do in the System!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519166/5230560244abc16b4a83c39ef271e99b1527c659.jpg[/img]

Update Assistants! 

Welcome to the System. Are you ready for a humorous escapade with OS9? See what’s waiting for you in [i]Backfirewall_[/i] from [b]Naraven Games[/b], available for PC and consoles!

Get the game here if you haven’t yet.

[h3]1. Explore the digital—dive into a smartphone[/h3]

We know that you always wanted to see how it REALLY works. Now you can—visit a unique microcosm and follow all those little processes that make the System a great place. You’ll visit various components of the phone along the way and their performance will surprise you.

[h3]2. Use cheat-codes to manipulate the environment[/h3]

When the Update process closes a door, make a new one and open it yourself with the power of cheat-codes! Bestowed on you by OS9, it’ll help you find your way in the System. Delete, open Colormode, Invert, and Duplicate as you create bugs to confuse the Update, trim binary trees, collect errors, delete data, master music-controlled platforms, and much more.

[h3]3. Solve clever puzzles[/h3]

Just in case you get bored, clever puzzles will keep you challenged. Use cheat-codes and observe the environment to review terminal errors in RAM, survive a party in the Speakers’ exclusive nightclub, and navigate through the maze of Wi-Fi bureaucracy.

[h3]4. Meet a colorful cast of app-characters[/h3]

The System is inhabited by various characters, from the neglected Health App to sassy Photos and optimistic Unzipper. Each of them has its distinct story, so make sure to find time to talk to them or eavesdrop.

[h3]5. Find numerous collectibles[/h3]

In addition to finding bugs, you’ll find emails scattered around the System. Pick them up to discover a parallel story of the mysterious phone User.

[h3]6. Enjoy unproductive and useless humor[/h3]

Breaking the fourth wall? Meta satirical humor? Yes, we have that! Chatty OS9 will provide you with a constant stream of comedy gold, complemented by other characters’ quips and situational humor.

notes.title: New Hotfix Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519166/ab912dea6fb36f3c10eadfc09974a2d2bd0cbf52.jpg[/img]

Update Assistants!

A new hotfix has arrived to solve softlock issues and more: [b]You can now restart a level if you get stuck[/b]. Please note that this allows you to replay only the current level, not any level in the game, and your progress in this level will be reset. See the full changelog below.

To access the Restart Level feature, open the pause menu and choose the Restart Level option.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a solution to softlock issues—a Restart Level feature: You can now load the save from when you entered a level for the first time.
[*] Fixed the broken USER PRIVA-WHAT? achievement (for collecting all User Messages).
[*] Fixed the bug with the inactive OS9 door in the Vault in Wi-Fi.
[*] The dialogue option with PID101 after handing Hector back to it now displays correctly regardless of whether players quit the game before or not.
[*] Self-inversion no longer interrupts gameplay after restarting a level.
[*] Fixed the bug with the observatory post leading back to hallucinations when restarted.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience as we’re working to ensure that the game works smoothly for everyone. If you encounter any issues, please report that here: [url=https://forms.gle/DmKhEejXkQzcqquR9]Bug Report Form Link[/url]

notes.title: Welcome to Backfirewall_!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519166/a21c40df4659e2d410cb7b0f3f3bd7ca67eeee8d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Welcome to the system![/h3]

Hello Players!

We’re [b]Naraven Games (developer)[/b] and [b]All in! Games (publisher)[/b]—and after many months of development we’ve finally announced [i]Backfirewall_[/i] at the PC Gaming Show today! It’s our new narrative game and we’re super excited to invite you to its unique setting and present the stories of its colorful inhabitants to you.

[previewyoutube=6nbbwkSf3x0;full][/previewyoutube]

Coming to Steam later this year, [i]Backfirewall_[/i] will take you on a tragicomic adventure with the chatty self-aware Operating System, OS9. Faced with replacement by the far-better-optimized OS10, OS9’s goal is simple: stop the phone from updating, and stay alive.

[h3]A demo version is coming tomorrow![/h3]

But that’s not the end of great news! [b]Steam Next Fest is starting tomorrow[/b] and we’re releasing a free demo version of [i]Backfirewall_[/i], which will be available for a whole week on Steam.

[h3] Add the game to your wishlist now! [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1920100/Backfirewall/

[h3]Join our Discord Community[/h3]

[h3]Backfirewall_ features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]clever puzzles[/b] - Review terminal errors in RAM, party in the Speakers’ exclusive nightclub, navigate through the Wi-Fi bureaucracy, and explore other areas of a smartphone. 

[*] [b]cheat-codes[/b] to manipulate the environment - Hunt down or create bugs, trim binary trees, master music-controlled platforms, collect errors, and delete data using special cheat-codes. 

[*] [b]a variety of app-characters[/b] - Gossip with colorful pieces of software—the sassy Photos, the insecure Social Media F, or the neglected Health, among others—and uncover their distinct side stories. 

[*] [b]numerous collectibles[/b] - Collect emails scattered about to discover a parallel story of the mysterious phone User. 

[*] [b]unproductive and useless humor[/b] - Enjoy meta satirical humor and breaking the fourth wall.
[/list]
